why: A mark's worth is energy: a container's is its build cost by the share of its hits left, and while a creep is a mark no structure is, so hunters strike the workers rather than plink a 250k-hit container beside them (sweep-casts-what-its-spawns-land's self-play start). `plinked` is a stricter proxy for the marks Hunt holds (`Scene::ground`, kept in no output): a sweep body's strikes on what was no creep that tick or the one before, in a room where his prey (`sweep::prey`) stood anywhere, where Hunt counts only prey beside the tiles it reaches and a shot at a body under his rampart lands on the rampart. On a2295a64, before, each seat's sweeps plinked on every seed 1-5; main 0. His bodies alpha's seat kills in a held sweep's room (destroyed the tick a body or tower of alpha's struck them last, the sweep's or not) are a guardrail, not a separator (the pre-fix build kills as many): 19-33 on seeds 1-5, bound about 30% under the least, 19 x 0.7 = 13; seed 2 since a forming set landed as one (seeds 1-5: main 22 26 10 27 23, after 11 20 27 12 17; the centre-first layout 22 on seed 2). HYPOTHESIS for the dry seeds (gate31 in the default checkout's .scratch/plan-stability): a sweep's candidate needs prey stirred in live vision, so once his rooms go unseen the sweeps stop and a dry spell follows, so a seat whose sweeps hold rooms it never strikes in fails (the count before also took in his bodies dying unstruck beside them, age-out and recycle: 35-49, bound 15). It runs seed 5 on the centre-first planner (agent): killedBeside on seeds 1-5, main 11/20/27/12/17 (seeds 1 and 4 fail), the centre-first stack 20/12/17/16/21 (seed 2 fails); seed noise around the bound, the dry-spell mechanism above
